source: Live provider read-only pg_get_functiondef; complete native SQL declarations and pg_proc metadata

findings.evidence: All 15 are standard PostgreSQL built-in window declarations, with native symbols and expected support hooks. Provider-managed, not DIC application object.
Window compiled native C/internal implementations not exposed by provider. SQL EXECUTE grant is not hosted RPC/API reachability.
